newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates Raiffeisen mark, dollar funds AAA.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Raiffeisen mark, dollar funds AAA.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it assigned AAA money market fund ratings to the mark money and the U.S. dollar money subfunds of the Raiffeisen Schweiz (Luxemburg) Fonds SICAV (the Fund).

"The fund is a Luxembourg registered open-end investment company. Each subfund is managed as a separate entity, and as such carries a separate Moody's rating. Moody's said the ratings reflect the superior quality of the subfunds' investments and the maintenance of a high level of liquidity. In addition to high investment quality and liquidity standards, Moody's ratings are based on the Fund's management style, as it relates to the stated objectives of the Fund. Moody's added, that the Fund's investment adviser, Vontobel Asset Management Ltd, is an experienced money manager. The rating agency also noted the Fund's well-developed trading, research, audit, and compliance systems. Moody's continued to say that it has been rating fixed income funds managed by Vontobel since January 1994. The Fund's overall objective is to achieve adequate yields on the currency and the assets of the relevant subfund, taking into account capital security and liquidity of the fund's assets. Long-term considerations based on economic criteria have priority over short-term high-risk profit optimization. The DM Money and the US Dollar Money subfunds goal is to achieve the best investment returns in Deutsche Marks and US Dollars, respectively. The Fund manager is Raiffeisen Schweiz (Luxemburg) Fonds Management S.A., Luxembourg, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Schweizer Verband der Raiffeisenbanken based in St. Gallen, Switzerland. The adviser is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Vontobel Holding AG, located in Zurich, Switzerland. Morgan Stanley Bank Luxembourg S.A. acts as the Funds custodian. Administrator of the Fund is Henderson International Luxembourg S.A.. Although the Fund qualifies for UCITS status under Luxembourg investment law and may be freely marketed within the EU as such, the Fund is registered for distribution in Switzerland only. The DM Money and US Dollar Money subfunds assets are invested at least two thirds in various high quality fixed income investments denominated in Deutsche Marks and US Dollars, respectively, while respecting the principle of risk diversification. All investments are rated by Moody4s. The currency risk of investments not denominated in each subfund's accounting currency will be entirely hedged. The maximum maturity of bonds is limited to 3 years, and that of floating rate notes to 7 years. The subfunds may also invest on an ancillary basis in cash, deposits, and short-term money market instruments with less than 12 months remaining maturity. The weighted average maturity of the subfunds may not exceed 18 months, initially it will be around 6 months. Investments in financial futures and options are allowed only for hedging purposes. The subfunds engage in securities lending with high-grade counterparties. Moody's money market fund ratings are opinions of the investment quality of shares in mutual funds which principally invest in short-term fixed-income obligations. The ratings are not intended to consider the prospective performance of a fund with respect to appreciation, volatility of net asset value, or yield. Money market funds rated Aaa are judged to be of an investment quality similar to Aaa-rated fixed income obligations -- that is they are judged to be of the best quality. Frankfurt Rudolf Siebel Vice President Funds & Derivatives Group Moody's Deutschland GmbH (69) 2 42 84-0 London Samuel Theodore Managing Director Financial Institutions Group Moody's Investors Service Ltd."
